simple.inThisVerse: The selected word is tied to כִּילַי (H3596) in the Hebrew source text. Part of speech: n-m.
simple.whyItMatters: This word appears 2 times in the Hebrew Bible, so BibleIQ can compare how Scripture uses it across multiple passages.
simple.summary: כִּילַי (kîylay) means niggardly First listed occurrence: Isa 32 5.

definitions.full: H3596. kilay or kelay כֵּלַי כִּילַי, Isa 32:5 , 7 see נכל (Kö ii. 118 ). כֵּלַי כִּילַי, noun masculine knave (for נְכִילַי see Kö ii.1, 118 ); — absolute כִּילַי Isa 32:5 (opposed to שׁוֺעַ , || נָבָל ); כֵּלַי 32:7 (assonance with כֵּלָיו , from כְּלִי q. v.).
definitions.rootNote: or כֵּלַי ; from 3557 in the sense of withholding ;
